Prompt

Create a thank you/confirmation page:

1. CONFIRMATION MESSAGE
Clear and immediate:
- "Thank You!" headline
- Confirmation of action taken
- Order/reference number
- What happens next
- Timeline expectations

2. DELIVERY DETAILS
Set expectations:
- Email confirmation sent
- Check spam folder note
- Delivery timeframe
- Access instructions
- Support contact

3. IMMEDIATE VALUE
Deliver something now:
- Instant download link
- Access credentials
- Quick start guide
- Video welcome message
- Bonus content

4. UPSELL OPPORTUNITY
Strategic offer:
- Complementary product
- Upgrade option
- One-time discount
- Bundle deal
- Limited time frame

5. UPSELL PRESENTATION
- "Wait! One More Thing..."
- "Exclusive Offer for New [Customers]"
- "Complete Your [X] With..."
- Comparison of with/without
- Clear value proposition

6. SOCIAL SHARING
Encourage spread:
- Share buttons
- Pre-written tweet/post
- Referral program intro
- "Tell a friend" incentive

7. NEXT STEPS
Guide the journey:
- What to do now
- What to expect
- How to get help
- Community invitation
- Calendar/reminder add

8. TRUST REINFORCEMENT
Validate decision:
- "Great choice!"
- Customer testimonials
- Results preview
- Success stories
- Community size

9. ENGAGEMENT HOOKS
Keep them connected:
- Follow on social
- Join community
- Subscribe to updates
- Book a call
- Take a survey

10. SUPPORT INFORMATION
Easy to find:
- FAQ link
- Help center
- Contact email
- Chat option
- Phone number

11. DESIGN ELEMENTS
- Celebratory visuals
- Checkmark/success icon
- Brand colors
- Clean layout
- Mobile friendly

12. TRACKING
- Conversion completion
- Upsell click tracking
- Social share tracking
- Time on page
- Scroll depth

Layout structure:
1. Success confirmation (top)
2. Delivery details
3. Immediate value/download
4. Upsell offer (if applicable)
5. Next steps
6. Social/community
7. Support info

Psychology tips:
- Reinforce good decision
- Create anticipation
- Offer immediate gratification
- Present upsell as helpful
- Build relationship
